reconciliation_rules: Current explicit collector/query/normalizer use is USED even when an additional downstream opportunity exists.
Fields not collected by the reviewed source families receive the reviewed stage5/stage9 opportunity or exclusion disposition.
Inspection source identity/address fields are useful only for QA/corroboration; redundant geography is excluded.
NYS Socrata georeference/computed-region fields are excluded because exact equipment ID plus source county/latitude/longitude already supply the relevant identity/geography.
A field normalized but not rendered is not automatically considered missing; retained-only downstream opportunities are recorded separately.

The permit source field applicant_middle_name is an additional identity-quality opportunity because the shared name normalizer anticipates it but the permit select contract does not currently request it.
boundary: This updates source-field dispositions through the first 16 reviewed dataset families. The remaining 275 fields are individually retained as UNRESOLVED pending the final source-family batch; no opportunity field is production-integrated by this audit.
